exposure: number of indications for prophylactic antibiotics
cohort: All deliveries from 1 January 2016 to 31 December 2018 at a tertiary level hospital in Indonesia
finding: The prevalence of prophylactic antibiotic use during delivery was 47.1%, and clinician adherence to guidelines was 68.9%, with lower adherence observed when patients had only one indication for antibiotics.
mod_finding: C-section was independently associated with prophylactic antibiotic use.
